nota: Os rótulos do ABS: 'Bitten or struck by dog (W54)', 'Bitten or struck by other mammals (W55)', 'Contact with marine animal (W56)', 'Bitten or struck by crocodile or alligator (W58)'. A CID-10: X20–X29 'Excl.: nonvenomous marine animals (W56)'. Peachey & Lower (resumo): 'The majority of incidents (81%) involved horses (n = 75) and cattle (n = 31)'; o resumo também dá 86 homens (66 %) e 54 mulheres, que somam 140, e 106/140 = 76 %, não 81 %: o resumo não fecha (86/0.66 = 130). Nenhum número deles na tela (DF-13).

texto_aprovado: If you've been waiting for the sharks and the crocodiles, this is where they turn up, and they have company. The death records count dogs and other mammals, animals in the sea, sharks among them, and crocodiles. On farms, a separate study found, most fatal incidents with animals involved horses or cattle.
